searchText: Hi, I want to add my notes to the GitHub repository - cohort-zero, do I just simply 'add file' or do i need a request? I guess you just open Pull request (PR) <@848181786763984926> just got the email with your PR, I think that project is 1) useful, 2) feasible in the relatively short time of the project 3) not trivial in that it pertains to different aspects of the protocol. In short I think it's great! I'm glad you like it!
